purpose: Securely manage, validate, and broker key/token capabilities for the AI ecosystem aligned with APΩ canon.

steps.name: audit_git_remotes
steps.description: Scan .git/config files under ~/ for remote URLs with embedded credentials. Report redacted URLs only.

steps.name: sanitize_leaked_remote_urls
steps.description: Remove embedded tokens from git remote URLs. Re-authenticate via gh or SSH afterward.

steps.name: build_env_templates
steps.description: Create .env.example templates in canonical project directories. Creator fills .env locally.

steps.name: reconcile_gh_auth
steps.description: Re-authenticate gh for NguyenCuong1989 and nguyencuong2509-sys using tokens provided in temporary files.

steps.name: mcp_registry_sync
steps.description: Sync MCP server instances into HyperAI-Sync runtime registry. Hardcoded placeholder tokens must be redacted before or after copy.

steps.name: load_and_label_all_credentials
steps.description: Parse the creator credential dump, label keys by provider, decode MISC_ENCODED_DATA, deduplicate, and write ~/.config/hyperai/credentials.env with mode 0600.

steps.name: activate_credentials_in_runtime
steps.description: Load all credentials into the active process environment and alias GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN to the active GITHUB_PAT.

steps.name: start_ap_omega_credential_broker
steps.description: Start FastAPI credential broker. It validates keys, evaluates Adm_Ω, issues scoped leases, and executes proxy calls with X-Lease-Id.

steps.name: deploy_docker_broker
steps.description: Build and run the credential broker as a container with credentials mounted read-only as /run/secrets/credentials.env.

steps.name: verify_and_close
steps.command: python tools/hyperai_credential_manager.py --all && python tools/hyperai_ooda_loop.py --task 'Verify credential management closure' --once
steps.description: Run credential manager audit and HyperAI OODA verification cycle. Produce proof artifacts.
